title: Automation Controller must utilize encryption when using LDAP for authentication.
check_content:
Log in to Automation Controller as an administrator and navigate to Settings >> Authentication >> LDAP settings.

If an LDAP server is configured but the "LDAP SERVER URI" field does not start with "ldaps://", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Log in to Automation Controller as an administrator and navigate to Settings >> Authentication >> LDAP settings.

Click "Edit".

Modify the "LDAP SERVER URI" field so that it begins with "ldaps://".

Click "Save".
VulnDiscussion: To avoid access with malicious intent, passwords will need to be protected at all times. This includes transmission where passwords must be encrypted for security.
